central_question: How does a controller affect the measured performance of a complete power converter?
claims_and_limits: ST reports Cortex-M33 at 280 MHz and twice STM32G4 compute performance, not twice system efficiency.
High-resolution timing can support faster switching but must be evaluated with sensing, SiC/GaN power stages and protection.
Dual-core products are planned for 2027; facility energy savings are not independently measured.

visual.shared_motif: Light technical editorial power-converter cutaway and distant server racks; cover identifies the system, inner image explains conceptual feedback and a separate protection path.
visual.status: Conceptual, not ST product photography or an electrical schematic.
